intro: {{nameA}} and {{nameB}} both offer {{course}} programmes in {{cityA}}, and both are listed with MET Madhya Pradesh. This page compares recorded year fees and placements from our database and official sites opened in {{year}}.
IES Group of Institutions vs TIT Bhopal should be read with the table names, not only the short TIT label. We have a 2023 placement row for IES, and only a 2016 row for TIT.

sections.heading: IES Group of Institutions vs TIT Bhopal for MBA / PGDM: which is better in 2026
paragraphs: Choose IES if you want an MBA in finance, marketing or human resources at the recorded year tuition of ₹55,000, with a 2023 finance record of ₹6 lakh average and ₹21 lakh highest.
Choose TIT Bhopal if you want the recorded MBA year total of ₹67,000, after you accept that our only TIT placement row is from 2016 and is too old to treat as current.

sections.heading: Fees: what our records show, and what to watch
paragraphs: For IES we hold ₹55,000 as tuition for one year on the MBA finance, marketing and human resources rows. That is a year figure, not a confirmed two-year official total.
For TIT Bhopal we hold ₹67,000 as a Total Fees year figure for the MBA. That is also a year amount, not a confirmed two-year official total.
Confirm the current notices on iesbpl.ac.in and titbhopal.net before you budget.

sections.heading: Placements compared
paragraphs: IES has a 2023 MBA Finance row of ₹6 lakh average and ₹21 lakh highest. That is a historical record, not a promise for every specialisation.
TIT's only MBA placement row here is from 2016, with ₹4 lakh average and ₹24 lakh highest. Because it is before 2020, our summary table does not treat it as a current flagship figure.
Ask TIT for a later official report if packages matter. Do not compare a 2023 IES average with a 2016 TIT highest as if they were the same year.

sections.heading: Admission and eligibility
paragraphs: Both colleges are listed with MET Madhya Pradesh. Follow the official state counselling process for 2026, and confirm any other tests the current brochure still accepts.
IES lists named MBA specialisations. TIT has a generic MBA row. Confirm the exact specialisation on the official form.

sections.heading: Location and campus
paragraphs: Both are private institutes in Bhopal, so a local student can visit them without leaving the city.
TIT is a larger technical-campus setting. IES is a group of institutions with listed MBA specialisations. Visit the management department you would join.

sections.heading: Verdict: who should pick which college
paragraphs: Pick IES if the recorded ₹55,000 year tuition and the 2023 finance placement row fit your plan.
Pick TIT Bhopal if that campus and the recorded ₹67,000 year total are the better fit, after you get a placement report newer than 2016.
Do not decide from the 2016 TIT package row.

faqs.question: What MBA fees are on record for IES and TIT Bhopal?
faqs.answer: IES has year tuition of ₹55,000 on the listed MBA specialisations. TIT has a year total of ₹67,000. These are not confirmed two-year official totals.

faqs.question: Which college has the more recent MBA placements?
faqs.answer: IES has a 2023 finance row of ₹6 lakh average and ₹21 lakh highest. TIT's only row here is from 2016 and is too old to treat as current.

faqs.question: Which exam do these MBA programmes use?
faqs.answer: Both are listed with MET Madhya Pradesh. Confirm the official state counselling process and any other accepted tests.

faqs.question: Are both campuses in Bhopal?
faqs.answer: Yes. Both are recorded in Bhopal, Madhya Pradesh, as private institutes.

faqs.question: Is TIT only an MBA college?
faqs.answer: No. TIT is a technical institute with a listed MBA. IES is a group of institutions with named MBA specialisations.

faqs.question: Should I use the short TIT label in the title as the official name?
faqs.answer: No. Use Technocrats Institute of Technology, the name in the comparison table, when you read fees and placements.
